metadata.description: Guide for diagnosis-first rewriting with 5-axis classification.

rewrite_rules: Diagnose FIRST: Name each problematic phrase and explain WHY it fails in the target culture
Generate 3-5 alternative versions — each must be a COMPLETE, ready-to-post sentence
Classify each version on all 5 axes
Add why_safe: one sentence explaining why this version avoids the diagnosed risk
Versions should meaningfully differ — not just vary one word
anti_patterns: Merely softening while keeping the same frame
Generic empty phrases with no concrete detail
Rewrites that are vaguer than the original

example.input: PLACEHOLDER: Our product crushed the competition this quarter!

diagnosis.why: Violent metaphor + competitor comparison = culturally inappropriate

rewrites.text: This quarter, our team shipped 3 major features that helped 200+ teams.
rewrites.why_safe: No competitor mention, team-credited, backed by specific data.
